answer: Uncertain. There may be a meteg on ר (resh), next to its tsere. There is a short vertical, comma-like stroke under the resh, just to the right of and slightly below the two tsere dots. I see no meteg on any other letter (ת, ס, second ת, י, נ, ו), at medium confidence.
visible_evidence: The whole word תסתירנו is visible with its lower points. I can see a patach dash under the first ת, a sheva or hiriq dot group in the ס/second ת area, two horizontal dots (tsere) around the י/ר area, and a separate small vertical tick to the right of and lower than those dots, under ר and before נ. The tick looks like a meteg in shape, but the resolution is too low to tell exactly which letter it sits under or to rule out a vowel stem or artifact. The next line's ink is below and does not reach the tick.
